analysisPlan.uncertainty: paired bootstrap interval for latency deltas; exact paired outcomes for success

infrastructureRules: A Claude wrapper telemetry record with claudeExitCode != 0 is an executor infrastructure failure and is excluded from scientific outcomes.
A timed-out command agent is an executor infrastructure failure and is excluded from scientific outcomes.
The matrix must stop immediately on the first infrastructure failure.
The failed cell index is not advanced; rerunning the same command retries exactly that scheduled cell.
Successful prior cells remain checkpointed and are not rerun during infrastructure resume.
The frozen schedule and baseline order do not change across resume operations.
The final scientific summary is emitted only after every scheduled cell has produced an analyzable outcome.
freezeRules: v0.3.1 changes execution accounting/checkpointing only; ontology, TaskPacks, graders, stateRequirements, worker profiles, matcher weights, context mappings, and role-selector semantics are unchanged from v0.3.
No scientific design parameter may change after a valid v0.3.1 real-agent outcome is inspected.
v0.2 remains a separate prospective null/ceiling result.
The aborted v0.3 attempt remains visible as infrastructure-invalid rather than being silently deleted.

v0.3.2 changes only executor portability/infrastructure telemetry. Scientific tasks, graders, ontology, role selector, worker profiles, matcher weights, context mappings, and hypotheses remain identical.
OpenAI/Codex outcomes are reported as a separate executor-family replication and are not pooled with Claude outcomes.

studyPurpose: Test whether authoritative evidence-aware re-execution unlocks useful Qwen 3.5 9B behavior after the one-shot local frontier showed 30/30 public-test passes, 30/30 authoritative failures, and 30/30 no implementation changes from the pre-action state.
hypotheses: Public-test completion is an insufficient stopping condition for the tested small local model.
Authoritative evidence feedback can induce implementation changes without revealing hidden expected outputs.
With equal attempt budgets, differences among B0/B1/B2/B3/P can be attributed to their frozen replanning and context-allocation semantics rather than unequal retries.

On ontology-stress retries, B3 remains constrained by the predefined role ontology while P can allocate the state-derived Need to workers situated in provenance/audit or schema-history/external-signal context.

recommendedStages.purpose: Confirm the local model can use Codex tools and produce nontrivial task outcomes.
Estimate success and latency by coordination condition without API cost.
Measure how coordination effects change with local model capability, conditional on hardware feasibility.

localRunRules: The evaluation set pins qwen3.5:9b and the model-locked runner rejects conflicting PLH_LOCAL_MODEL values before cell 0.
Each baseline receives at most three executor attempts per cell.
Every attempt is followed by the same authoritative external grader.
Feedback excludes hidden expected outputs and assertion diffs.
All baselines receive the same feedback obligations; their only difference is frozen coordination/replanning semantics.
Do not pool these evidence-loop outcomes with the prior one-shot 4B/9B frontier runs.

evidenceLoop.stoppingRule: stop only when authoritative external-grader evidence satisfies the frozen evidence obligation or the equal attempt budget is exhausted
evidenceLoop.feedbackPolicy: expose frozen unsatisfied obligation identifiers/descriptions and derived context/capability requirements only; never expose assertion diffs, expected outputs, or grader source
evidenceLoop.replanRule: after each unsatisfied authoritative grade, all baselines are replanned using the same derived state requirements under their frozen coordination semantics
